messages:
maria_sales: FYI FinServeX wants a 4-week POC. They need us to confirm hosting option (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), region (US/EU), rough pricing delta, and answers to the security questionnaire. Can we align on success criteria and a short runbook?

aj_presales: Thanks Maria. Key constraints from customer: PHI adjacency (not storing raw PII), dedicated throughput during peak hours, and SOC2 + encryption in transit at rest. They prefer Dedicated but want cost comparators for Hosted first.

kevin_eng: Short take — Dedicated gives predictable latency and isolation which they care about. Private (VPC/on‑prem) is heavier — requires infra (+4–6 weeks) and our standard support add-on. Hosted is fastest to stand up but we’ll need to confirm data residency and contract terms.

olivia_prod: Proposed success criteria (suggested):
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for <512 token requests during peak burst (20 qps)
- Cost: token cost delta vs hosted baseline < 2.5x for Dedicated with reserved capacity plan
- Quality: end-to-end F1 on redacted PII extraction >= 0.88 on their eval set
- Reliability: 99.9% availability across POC window

sam_se: Security items from questionnaire flagged: key management (they require KMS/HSM integration), audit logs export, tenant isolation proof for Dedicated, and data deletion SLA. I can draft answers but need eng confirmation on HSM availability and log retention export formats.

maria_sales: timeline: kickoff next Mon (ts 1851234600) — they want a 2-week engineering validation and 2-week user evaluation. Can we promise a dedicated pool within that 4-week window if contract signed this week?

kevin_eng: If they commit to a dedicated reservation we can provision a Dedicated pool in ~5 business days (we have spare capacity in us-west). Private on-prem is out for 4-week. Hosted takes <1 day to switch a model; but we won't be able to demo guaranteed isolation.

aj_presales: Pricing quick note: Hosted baseline = usage pricing. Dedicated reserved commit adds monthly flat + lower per-token. Back-of-envelope: for their estimated 2M tokens/month — Hosted ~ $X, Dedicated (small reserved) ~ 1.9x hosted upfront but 0.6x per-token effective at scale. Will follow up with numbers.

sec-qa-bot: Auto-check results: 
- SOC2: controls documented, evidence repo id: ctrl-2024-112
- KMS/HSM: supported via partner KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), HSM on Private only.
- Audit logs: export JSON newline via S3/GCS.

maria_sales: Customer asked about region residency: they have EU customers but corp HQ is in US. Prefer EU processing for EU users. Do we support region-split routing for POC?

kevin_eng: We can route EU traffic to eu-central hosted instances. For Dedicated we can provision in europe-west but will need a separate reservation. Cross-region fallback is possible but increases latency. Recommend: host EU eval on Hosted eu region for speed, run Dedicated in US for isolation tests.

olivia_prod: Eval plan (short):
1) Week 1: Hosted eu + us smoke tests, baseline latency and quality metrics on their prompt set.
2) Week 2: Provision Dedicated US pool, run isolation & throughput tests.
3) Week 3: Customer user acceptance in EU (Hosted) and stress tests on Dedicated.
4) Week 4: Wrap-up, runbook handoff, and contract/legal checklist.

aj_presales: Success gating for signoff:
- Engineering signoff (p95 latency and throughput)
- Security signoff (KMS + logs + data retention answers accepted)
- Business signoff (cost within expected budget + user UAT pass)

sam_se: Action items: 
- I will fill the security questionnaire answers by EOD (ts 1851234575).
- Kevin to confirm HSM availability and exact log export schema (ts 1851234582).
- AJ to send rough pricing slide for Hosted vs Dedicated by tomorrow morning.

kevin_eng: Confirming HSM is Private-only. For Dedicated we support KMS and bring-your-own-key via KMS integration. Log schema: newline-delimited JSON with fields {timestamp, request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, route}. I'll attach sample in follow-up.

maria_sales: customer blocker: legal asked for data deletion SLA — can we give 30-day deletion for POC artifacts?

sam_se: We can offer a 30-day deletion SLA for Hosted and Dedicated POC artifacts; Private depends on their infra controls but we can document procedures.

deploy-bot: Reminder — to provision Dedicated pool please submit service request: `POST /internal/provision` payload: `{"customer":"FinServeX","region":"us-west","size":"small-reserved"}`. Change window: 2 business days.

olivia_prod: I'll draft a one-page POC runbook and success criteria doc to share with the customer (includes prompts, eval scripts, evasion cases, and rollback plan). Target share by EOD tomorrow.

maria_sales: Great — if we can get pricing + sec answers + runbook by tomorrow we can lock the signed order and start provisioning. Thanks team :thumbsup:

aj_presales: Will do.

kevin_eng: I'll attach the sample log output and a short note on latencies for 256 vs 512 tokens in the follow-up thread.

sam_se: Security answers submitted (ts 1851234595).

maria_sales: last quick Q from customer — if Dedicated capacity drops, can we fallback to Hosted model automatically?

kevin_eng: Yes — we support smart routing/fallback to compatible Hosted model. You'll want a policy: prefer Dedicated, fallback to Hosted eu/us depending on region, with rate limit protections. I'll add this to the runbook.

maria_sales: Perfect. Locking this thread for the day.
